text:
oncall-bot: Pager: geo-dns probes are reporting divergence across eu-west-1 edge resolvers and global resolver pool (Route53 vs Cloudflare). Error rate: query mismatch ~3.4% for the last 5m. Probing: failed to resolve service.example.com -> inconsistent answers.

oncall-bot: Impact tags: potential customer latency/errors for geo-routed endpoints. Suggested runbook: geodns/validate-and-failover.

alex: seeing the same in dashboards — spike in 502s from frontend in eu-west-1 and elevated DNS lookup latencies. Synthetic probes show Route53 returning different A-records than Cloudflare for ~12% of queries from eu-west probes (parity mismatch).

maya: confirmed via packet captures — some resolvers returning stale cached NXDOMAIN while others return healthy A (TTL divergence). Likely propagation/backfill issue between external providers or sudden cache invalidation.

support_josh: 3 customers have opened tickets about 5xx gateway errors in EU regions, one mention that API requests to embedding endpoints get intermittent host not found. Marking initial customer impact S2, but escalating if more reports come in.

ops_lead: @cheng can you run the geodns failover plan? We want to bias routing away from the noisy resolver (detected by probe tag cf-eu-west-1) and prefer route53 answers for region eu-west-1 for the next 15 mins while we investigate. Post the exact commands you run. :thumbsup:

cheng: running the weight change now. Command: 
```
# internal tool: rwdnsctl
rwdnsctl set-weight --region eu-west-1 --weights cloudflare=10,route53=90 --reason "emergency: resolver divergence 5100001111"
```

deploy-bot: rwdnsctl: change accepted. plan-id=plan-78321, executing rollout to eu-west-1 pools.

maya: triggering additional active probes and extended capture on both resolver pools. Also dumping recent Route53 change logs to check for recent TTL/record updates.

alex: quick check: auth logs show no large change events. Cloudflare status page currently shows no global incident but some EU edge performance warnings in the last hour. Adding Cloudflare ticket to triage.

support_josh: noted — informing affected customers we're investigating and implementing temporary routing fallback. Template used: "We've implemented a temporary routing change to stabilize DNS responses while we investigate. We'll update within 30 minutes."

oncall-bot: Monitoring: error-rate decreased from 3.4% -> 0.6% within 90s of the weight change. Latency percentiles trending back to baseline.

cheng: rollout completed. Verification: 
- probe success rate (eu-west): 99.2%
- sample checks vs 3rd party resolvers: consistent answers now.

ops_lead: good. keep the weighting for 20m and then gradually revert if stable. @sre_kate can you take oncall for the next shift and follow up with Cloudflare/Route53 support threads for RCA?

sre_kate: taking handoff. I'll keep the bias in place and run a controlled revert in 30m if metrics remain stable. Will open a postmortem draft and collect probe samples/logs.

alex: quick note for postmortem: capture differential TTLs, provider-side cache invalidation events, and whether our health probes contributed to cache churn. Also add the exact timestamps for the weight flip and probe improvements.

support_josh: I'll follow up with the 3 customers and update their tickets with the stabilization note + ETA for post-incident follow up.

maya: saved captures and uploaded to incident bucket: s3://redwood-incidents/5100001111/pcaps and probe-logs.

deploy-bot: audit: action=rwdns-weight-change actor=cheng plan-id=plan-78321 region=eu-west-1 timestamp=5100001402

oncall-bot: Incident state: mitigated (temporary routing bias applied). Next actions: 1) SRE to own revert plan, 2) Eng to coordinate with CF/R53 support, 3) Postmortem in 48h.

sre_kate: Affirmative. I'll include customer impact summary and timeline. Assigning follow-ups: CF ticket -> maya, R53 ticket -> alex, postmortem owner -> sre_kate.

ops_lead: thanks team. Keep updates to this thread. If anything regresses (error rate >1% for 5m) we escalate immediately and consider full failover.

cheng: logging off after final check. All good from my side.

support_josh: closing customer-facing update: "Routing change applied, please let us know if issues persist. We will follow up with a detailed RCA."

oncall-bot: Closing note will be added once postmortem is filed. :white_check_mark:
